title: Standard MURDLE — Release Day
subtitle: Standard mode: 5 suspects, 5 weapons, 5 locations
storyTitle: The Case of the Corrupted Package
storyHtml:
A release package was corrupted just before deployment. Five Dynavics specialists were working across the office, each with a different item.

Find who caused the failure, what they used, and where it happened.

clues.text: Finn was in the Test Lab.
The USB Key was used in the Test Lab.
Ruby was in the Boardroom with the Tablet.
Theo worked in the App Studio.
The Scanner was in the App Studio.
The Laptop was in the Support Hub.
The Cable was not in the Demo Suite.
The Notebook was found in the Demo Suite.
